newsitem.title: USA: Telco selected for travel agent group.
newsitem.headline: Telco selected for travel agent group.

text.p: Telco Communications Group Inc said Thursday that ASTA Marketing Services Inc has selected Telco as its new, exclusive provider of long distance telecommunications services to the more than 18,000 members and affiliates of the American Society of Travel Agents (ASTA) in the United States.

The company said ASTA members will receive a flat-rate long distance interstate calling rate of $0.099 per minute, with no volume usage commitment or term contract, for both outbound and toll-free service.
Telco is a national provider of long distance telecommunications products and services targeting residential, commercial and carrier customers.
